creatures.name: Acromantula
creatures.summary: An Acromantula was a giant magical species of spider native to the rainforests of Southeast Asia, particularly Borneo, where it inhabited dense jungles. Acromantulas were believed to be a wizard-bred species, designed to guard dwellings or treasure hoards, and were first created before the Ban on Experimental Breeding in 1965. These giant spiders had a taste for human flesh and were first spotted in 1794. Despite their danger to wizardkind, there existed at least one group dedicated to protecting the species, the Société de Protection des Acromantules, based in the Place Cachée in Paris.

creatures.name: Ashwinder
creatures.summary: The Ashwinder was a magical serpent that was created from the remains of any magical fire that was allowed to burn unchecked.

creatures.name: Augurey
creatures.summary: The Augurey, also known as the Irish Phoenix, was a thin and mournful looking magical bird, somewhat like a small underfed vulture in appearance, with greenish black feathers and a sharp beak.

creatures.name: Basilisk
creatures.summary: The Basilisk was a giant serpent, also known as the King of Serpents. It was a magical beast that was usually bred by Dark wizards. Herpo the Foul was the first to breed a Basilisk. Herpo accomplished this by hatching a chicken egg beneath a toad which resulted in the creature known as a Basilisk.
creatures.feathers: Scarlet plume on the head (if male)
distinctions: Venomous fangs, which are extremely poisonous

creatures.name: BatFish
creatures.summary: A BatFish was a magical creature, possibly a hybrid between a bat and a fish.
distinctions: Possibly a hybrid between a bat and a fish

creatures.name: Big-horn sheep
creatures.summary: The big-horn sheep was a magical species of sheep. It had a body covered in wool and was distinguished by an enormous single horn in the shape of a plate.

creatures.name: Billywig
creatures.summary: The Billywig was a magical insect native to Australia. It was rated XXX, and was around half an inch long and of a vivid sapphire blue colour. The speed of the Billywig may be why it was rarely noticed by Muggles, and wizards and witches often only spotted it once they had been stung.

creatures.name: Blast-Ended Skrewt
creatures.summary: The Blast-Ended Skrewt was a magical hybrid beast bred by Rubeus Hagrid in the autumn of 1994 by cross-breeding Manticores and Fire Crabs. Whether Hagrid used magic or somehow got the two different species to mate remains unknown.
distinctions: Resemble pale, slimy, deformed shell-less lobsters or scorpions
Males have stingers, females have suckers to suck blood
Shoot fire from their rear end

creatures.name: Bowtruckle
creatures.summary: The Bowtruckle was a hand-sized, insect-eating, tree dwelling magical beast with long sharp fingers (two on each hand), brown eyes, and a general appearance of a flat-faced stick figure made of bark and twigs, which served well as camouflage in its natural habitat.

creatures.name: Bundimun
creatures.summary: It was a greenish, many-eyed pest that fed on dirt. The creature crept under floorboards and behind skirting boards, infesting houses. Their presence was indicated by the foul stench of decay. The secretions of the Bundimun were extremely acidic and could rot building structures. A large enough infestation could cause a building to collapse as the foundations were rotted away. Scouring Charms could clear out small infestations, but large colonies needed to be dealt with by the Department for the Regulation and Control of Magical Creatures (Pest Sub-Division). Bundimuns spat out its acidic ooze when annoyed, but when diluted, were used in some magical cleaning solutions.
distinctions: Acidic secretion, capable of rotting building structures

creatures.name: Caipora
creatures.summary: The Caipora were small and furry spirit-beings who were extraordinarily mischievous. Native to the Amazon rainforest, they protected the grounds of Castelobruxo wizarding school, emerging under cover of night to watch over the students and the creatures that live in the forest.
distinctions: Protect the grounds of Castelobruxo at night

creatures.name: Catfish
creatures.summary: The catfish was a magical fish, possibly a hybrid between a cat and a fish. Its slender body and long tail were similar to those of a fish, and it had four legs with webbed feet suitable for swimming. Its head was flattened and it had long whiskers and a mouth with sharp teeth.
distinctions: Possibly a hybrid between a cat and a fish
Has four legs with webbed feet

creatures.name: Catoblepas
creatures.summary: A Catoblepas was a bull-like magical beast which had two sharp tusks and a pair of long curled horns. It likely lived in a shallow swamp.

creatures.name: Centaur
creatures.summary: A centaur was a magical creature whose head, torso, and arms appeared to be human and were joined to a horse's lower body. They were, however, their own individual species, and thus were not half-breeds. They also had a rich history and were known for being naturally talented in archery, healing magic, divination and astronomy.
creatures.native_to: Europe, including, Greece, Great Britain, Croatia
distinctions: Lower torso is a horse's body
Higher torso is a human's body
Capable of human intelligence and speech
Skilled in Astronomy, Healing magic and Divination

creatures.name: Chimaera
creatures.summary: The Chimaera was a type of hybrid animal and a violent magical beast native to Greece. It had a lion's head, a goat's body and a dragon's tail. Chimaeras were known for their vicious and bloodthirsty behaviour.

creatures.name: Chizpurfle
creatures.summary: The Chizpurfle was a type of very small magical parasite. Crab-like in appearance, this beast could grow up to a twentieth of an inch including its fangs. They were attracted to sources of magic and were commonly found in the fur and feathers of Crups and Augureys, respectively. The carapaces and fangs of the Chizpurfle were used in potion-making.
creatures.length: Up to a twentieth of an inch (with fangs)

creatures.name: Chupacabra
creatures.summary: The Chupacabra was a part-lizard, part-homunculus, blood-sucking magical beast which was native to North America and most likely South America.

creatures.name: Crup
creatures.summary: A Crup was a wizard-bred dog that originated in the southeast of England.

creatures.name: Demiguise
creatures.summary: The Demiguise was a peaceful, herbivorous magical beast that could turn itself invisible and see the future, both abilities which made it very sought-after. However, it was difficult to catch and could give a nasty nip if provoked.

creatures.name: Diricawl
creatures.summary: The Diricawl (known to Muggles as the Dodo) was a plump, fluffy-feathered and flightless magical bird, native to the island of Mauritius in the Indian Ocean. It was capable of disappearing and reappearing elsewhere, except when under the effects of Levioso. Diricawl eggs were green in colour.

creatures.name: Domestic beast
creatures.summary: There was a domestic creature that looked like a sloth with a tortoise shell. It was used as a table in wizards‘ and witches’ houses.

creatures.name: Double-ended newt
creatures.summary: The double-ended newt was a magical beast consisting of two newts sharing the same body. They tended to swim around a lot and preferred to eat algae. Double-ended newts were often kept as pets by wizards and witches, and could be purchased from the Magical Menagerie in Diagon Alley.

creatures.name: Doxy
creatures.summary: The Doxy, sometimes referred to as the Biting Fairy, was a small fairy-like magical beast, sometimes mistaken for a fairy. Preferring cold climates, the Doxy was found throughout Northern Europe and North America.

creatures.name: Dragon
creatures.summary: Dragons were giant winged, fire-breathing reptilian beasts. Widely regarded as terrifying yet awe-inspiring, they could be found all over the world and were frequently referred to in Asian and medieval European folklore. Able to fly and breathe fire through their nostrils and mouths, they were one of the most dangerous and hardest to conceal creatures in the wizarding world.

creatures.name: Dragon Shark
creatures.summary: A Dragon Shark was a massive shark-like creature that sheltered in the deep ocean.

varitas.propietario_conocido: Antioch Peverell, Emeric el Malvado, Gregorovitch, Gellert Grindelwald, Albus Dumbledore, Draco Malfoy, Harry Potter
Charlie Weasley, transferida posteriormente a Ron Weasley

escobas.uso_caracteristicas: Escoba de carreras de nivel profesional de máxima categoría internacional. Acelera de 0 a 240 km/h en 10 segundos. Mango de fresno pulido con ramitas de abedul seleccionadas a mano, equilibrio aerodinámico insuperable y freno de corte automático patentado.

Líder de ventas tras su lanzamiento en 1991. Mango estilizado de caoba pulida y cerdas de abedul. Diseñada para alto rendimiento en Quidditch, combina velocidad punta superior con giros suaves y maniobrabilidad precisa.

Evolución directa de la Nimbus 2000 acabada en tonalidad gris carbón pulido. Diseñada con aceleración optimizada que superó a su predecesora; adoptada íntegramente por el equipo de Quidditch de Slytherin en 1992.

Escoba deportiva duradera de gama media lanzada en 1995. Construida en madera de roble español con encantamiento antiturbulencias y control de frenado seguro; utilizada por Ron Weasley como Guardián de Gryffindor.

Modelo confiable para el aprendizaje y juego recreativo. Provista de un encantamiento amortiguador para comodidad del jinete y desaceleración progresiva ante maniobras abruptas; utilizada por Cho Chang y Nymphadora Tonks.

Escoba económica y popular en su lanzamiento en 1955, pero pronto obsoleta por pérdidas repentinas de velocidad y altura a medida que envejecía. Utilizada principalmente para clases de vuelo de primer año en Hogwarts.

casas.fantasma: Sir Nicholas de Mimsy-Porpington (Nick Casi Decapitado)

sala_comun.acceso: Cuadro de la Dama Gorda que solicita una contraseña cambiante
sala_comun.caracteristicas: Habitación circular espaciosa decorada con tapices medievales, sillones mullidos y una chimenea de leña constante.

sala_comun.ubicacion: Mazmorras del Castillo (Bajo las aguas del Lago Negro)
sala_comun.acceso: Muro de piedra desnuda que requiere una contraseña verbal
sala_comun.caracteristicas: Cripta subterránea de techos abovedados, lámparas verdosas colgantes, chimenea tallada con serpientes y ventanas con vistas al lecho del lago.

sala_comun.acceso: Aldaba de bronce en forma de águila que formula un acertijo lógico
sala_comun.caracteristicas: Espacio amplio y circular con ventanas en arco, alfombra azul medianoche, techo abovedado pintado con constelaciones y una estatua de mármol de la fundadora.

sala_comun.ubicacion: Sótano de Hufflepuff (Junto a las cocinas del castillo)
sala_comun.acceso: Pila de barriles; se debe golpear el segundo barril desde abajo al ritmo de 'Helga Hufflepuff'
sala_comun.caracteristicas: Ambiente acogedor, cálido y terroso con techos bajos, plantas colgantes abundantes, muebles de madera de roble y ventanas circulares a ras del césped.
